text:
zoe: Quick startup  were rolling a "Recognition Roadshow" for managers next month: 30min drop-in office hours + short tax/Q&A. Goal: help managers write stronger nominations and surface any policy questions before the monthly payout. Need volunteers to run regional slots and one person to own the manager cheat-sheet. Signup form: https://forms.gle/roadshow-managers (pick time zone).

andy: I can take the West Coast slot (Mon 12pm PT). Happy to walk through 3 live examples. Will need slides + cheat-sheet.

maria: Ill do the UK/EU slot (Tue 9am GMT). Can we make guidance about payroll cutoff front-and-center? Managers often miss timing.

lucy: Ill draft the 1-page manager cheat-sheet: eligibility bullets, example phrasing, tax note, and a quick checklist for approvals. Will share a doc by Friday.

finance-bot: Note: monthly spot award payroll cutoff is the 18th of each month at 11:59pm PT for inclusion in that months payroll. Late submissions will process next cycle. Reimbursements separate.

payroll-bot: Also: for international recipients, local tax treatment varies. Please include recipient country on the nomination form. People Ops will flag complex cases to Compensation.

kai: For APAC, I can run two slots (Mon 10am SGT and Thu 4pm AEST). Can we offer a recorded 10min walkthrough for managers who cant make live times?

sara: I can handle recording + publishing to the People Ops Learning page. Will also add captions.

zoe: Perfect. Logistics asks: 1) volunteers for slots (andy, maria, kai), 2) cheat-sheet owner (lucy), 3) recorded walkthrough (sara), 4) a reviewer for tax language (finance-bot or payroll team). Also need someone to coordinate small appreciation swag packs for nominees (stickers + thank-you card) and confirm budget.

andy: I can coordinate swag procurement and estimate costs. Any budget cap?

finance-bot: Suggested budget: $5 per nominee for small swag; approve up to $500 per month under project REC-ROADSHOW. Submit PO via procurement.

maria: Question: should managers be encouraged to anonymize quotes if they plan to publish nominee highlights externally? Need a short consent bullet.

lucy: I'll add a consent checkbox to the nomination form: "I have permission to share this quote publicly" with options for anonymized or internal-only.

zoe: Nice. Final ask: please add your slot availability in the form by EOD Wednesday. Lucy, once your cheat-sheet is ready, post it here and I'll make the calendar invites + Zoom links. We'll run the roadshow for two weeks and then reassess attendance.

kai: One small note: can we include a 1-slide legal/eligibility summary for managers who are people managers vs IC-led peer nominations? Some confusion there.

sara: I'll include that as a short FAQ in the recording description.

zoe: Thanks everyone  this should help reduce last-minute corrections and speed processing. Will loop in Comp/Legal for any flagged cases. :rocket:
